messages:
deploy-bot: Initiating staged blue/green swap for service router-proxy in eu-west1. Plan: shadow 10% for 10m -> ramp 25% for 15m -> 50% for 20m. Rollback allowed at any step. Change window 22:00-02:00 UTC. Release pinned to candidate v3.1.0. Links: release notes https://redwood.internal/releases/v3.1.0, canary dashboard https://grafana.internal/d/routers/router-proxy-canary
julie: ack. pin confirmed to v3.1.0. no infra migrations. remember to disable autoscaler bursts during ramp (keeps backend counts stable).
alex: noted, I'll set min/max to the current value +1 to avoid scale noise. Also enabling drain-grace of 30s on old pool.
maria: watching healthcheck and p95. will post if anything crosses thresholds. slack alert group @sre on watch.
deploy-bot: shadow traffic started -> 10% routed to blue variant. Observability: no errors, 200s steady.
ops-duty: quick ask — can we set circuit-breaker to 10% error threshold for this window? want faster failover.
sre-lead: agree. set cb to 10% for 30m. also reduce retry count to 0 for proxied requests.
deploy-bot: ramping to 25% now (step 2). ETA 15m.
deploy-bot: metric-check: p95 latency increased 28% on blue at 25% (baseline 170ms -> 218ms). error-rate remained under 1%.
maria: saw the p95 bump on grafana. not a steady trend yet but correlated with large object requests.
julie: hold the ramp. pause further shifts. leave blue at 25% and collect 10 more minutes of data.
alex: paused. pin note: if we rollback we should mark v3.1.0 as canary and keep traffic tests isolated. Also capturing KV cache warming metrics.
deploy-bot: pause confirmed. collecting extended metrics for 10m. autoscaler adjustments retained.
(7m later)
deploy-bot: extended metrics show p95 spike persisted ~9m during peak fanout. spike correlates with sequence length >512 tokens.
maria: suggestion: try reduced max-seq on router-proxy blue variant to 512 as a temp mitigation and re-run small ramp?
sre-lead: we can try config override, but that changes client experience. prefer rollback to stable if user-facing latency is impacted.
julie: decision: abort the ramp. rollback to green (release-2026-03-12-stable). We'll pin routing back and drain blue. Notify product.
deploy-bot: initiating rollback: shifting traffic off blue -> decreasing to 0% over 5 minutes, draining connections.
alex: running drain command: ```routerctl swap --service router-proxy --from blue --to green --grace 30 --force-drain```
ops-duty: setting circuit-breaker back to default 50% and enabling retries=2.
deploy-bot: rollback complete. traffic at 0% to blue, all requests served by green. healthchecks steady.
maria: verifying metrics, p95 back to baseline. no error spikes.
julie: filing post-rollout note: will add to release notes that v3.1.0 caused tail latency regressions for long sequences in eu-west1 and is under investigation. tagging @ml-team for model quantization check.
julie: follow-up actions: 1) revert config changes to autoscaler at 00:05 UTC, 2) keep canary tag on v3.1.0 and block full rollout until ML fix, 3) cross-team postmortem scheduled tomorrow 09:30 UTC.
sre-lead: thanks everyone. thread closed after postmortem created. deploy-bot: created ticket RED-4321 for rollback root cause and linked to release notes.
